definition.simple: When an acid and a base mix together and cancel each other out, making salt and water.
definition.academic: A chemical reaction in which an acid and a base react quantitatively with each other to produce salt and water, usually with the evolution of heat.

examples: Taking an antacid (base) to cure acidity (acid) in the stomach

common_misconceptions: Neutralization means the substance simply disappears. (Correction: The substances change into entirely new substances: salt and water.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Explain this as a battle between two opposite forces (Acid and Base) where both lose their powers and create something harmless (Salt and Water).
